headline_html:
1.6.0 — BreadBowl-Embed slots

Core, PyPI, and npm logosdb at 1.6.0. BreadBowl-Embed v1.3 stores 16 routing rows per passage, 256 dimensions, inner product. Reranking calls model.score() on the value vectors saved beside the index. A CPU SciFact table (nDCG@10, recall@100, index size, latency) is in the README. logosdb-mcp-server is 1.4.5 (^1.6.0).
